overview_description.description: Enza is a financial services company that specializes in providing innovative payment solutions. With a focus on fostering financial inclusion and encouraging the digitization of payments, Enza aims to serve the vibrant fintech and payments ecosystem in Africa. The company offers a rich API environment, allowing clients to focus on solving business challenges without the need to invest in complex payment infrastructure. Enza's services are designed to meet the needs of African banks and fintech companies, supporting the continent's growing ecommerce and digital payments sector.

product.name: Consumer Payment Solutions
product.description: Enza provides a range of consumer payment solutions, including card issuance and processing, fraud prevention, and support for various payment schemes, tailored to meet the needs of African markets.

product.name: Payment Orchestration (Enza Conductor)
product.description: Enza Conductor is a payment orchestration solution that simplifies online payment management for merchants, offering features like smart transaction routing and comprehensive analytics.

product.name: In-person Payments
product.description: Enza offers a platform for in-person payments, supporting various methods such as cards, QR codes, and account-to-account transfers, with options for dynamic currency conversion and fraud management.

product.name: Cloud-native Agility
product.description: Enza provides cloud-native payment solutions that are scalable and adaptable to different regulatory environments, enhancing business capabilities across multiple platforms.

product.name: enza payments capabilities
product.description: A payments technology service enabling banks, financial institutions and fintechs in Ghana to process digital payments with speed, scalability and local relevance.
